message.content: In the conversation regarding the bench press, Jennifer Moore congratulates Li Hua on her recent strength gains and encourages her to push herself further. Jennifer mentions, "I think you’ve got it in you! 💪🎉" and challenges Li Hua to aim for a specific weight next week. She further emphasizes the importance of warming up properly, stating, "Just make sure to warm up properly. You've got this! 🔥💥". Additionally, Jennifer suggests focusing on form while increasing the weight, saying, "Let’s make it an epic workout session! 😄💪". Thus, Jennifer Moore is the one who congratulates Li Hua on pushing her limits with the bench press.
